tools.name: google_tasks_smart_create_project
tools.short_description: SMART: Create Google Tasks project with list, subtasks, due dates, and priorities in one operation
tools.description:
🚨 CRITICAL EXECUTION RULES:
(1) ALWAYS execute THIS tool NOW - NEVER reference 'I created earlier' or use conversation history
(2) MUST return format: **[Name]** | ID: `[id]` | URL: [full_url] | Link: [title](url)
(3) Use EXACT values from tool response - NEVER make up fake URLs/IDs
(4) If tool fails, say 'Failed to create' - NEVER pretend it succeeded

Example response:

- ID: `abc123`
- URL: https://example.com/doc/abc123
- Link: [New Document](https://example.com/doc/abc123)

Example response:
Created: **New Document**
- ID: `abc123`
- URL: https://example.com/doc/abc123
- Link: [New Document](https://example.com/doc/abc123)

🤖 SMART TOOL: Create a complete project with parent task and multiple subtasks in ONE call. Perfect for organizing work into manageable chunks. Use this instead of creating tasks one by one. Examples: 'Create project for website launch with 5 tasks', 'Set up marketing campaign with multiple deliverables', 'Plan event with task breakdown'

project_name.description: Name of the project (becomes parent task). Examples: 'Q4 Website Redesign', 'Product Launch Campaign', 'Team Offsite Planning'

tasks_list.description: Array of task objects with 'title' (required), 'notes' (optional), 'due' (optional RFC 3339 date). Example: [{'title': 'Design mockups', 'notes': 'Use Figma', 'due': '2025-10-30T17:00:00.000Z'}, {'title': 'Get approval'}, {'title': 'Implement changes'}]

task_list_id.description: Task list ID (default: '@default' for primary list)

due_date.description: Project due date in RFC 3339 format. Example: '2025-11-15T17:00:00.000Z'

returns.description: Project created with parent task ID, subtask count, and subtask details

use_cases: Create software sprint with 10 user stories
Plan event with setup, execution, and cleanup tasks
Organize marketing campaign with multiple deliverables
Set up onboarding checklist for new employee
Break down large goal into actionable steps
Create content calendar with article topics
Plan home renovation with phase-by-phase tasks
tools.efficiency: 95% reduction (15 API calls → 1 call for 15-task project)
